title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: A midseason check-in
hook: Halfway through the season. Have you checked in with parents?
intro: The first email went out months ago.
Since then, it has mostly been schedule changes.
statement: A short midseason note keeps everyone on the same page.
q1: Do you send a midseason update on how the team is doing —
q2: or keep communication to logistics only?
q3: What have parents not heard from you yet?
t1: Both can work. But trust grows
t2: when parents hear about progress, not just schedules.
cta: Coaches — do you send a midseason update?
ctaLines: What we worked on. What is next. A thank-you.
ctaPrompt: Share your parent habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Halfway through the season. Have you checked in with parents?
The first email went out months ago. Since then, it has mostly been schedule changes.
A short midseason note keeps everyone on the same page.
A midseason update or logistics only. There is no single right way.
Do you send a midseason update? Share your habit in the comments.
